notes.title: Update From Corporate
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
The manual save button has been removed, the game now auto-saves much more often

Reset all progress button has been added to the main menu

New run button in the options panel has been changed to read abandon run, same functionality

The start run button in the main menu has been changed to continue, same functionality

Updates to the environment art have been made

Minor updates to the particle effects have been made

BUG FIXES
[hr][/hr]
The corruption eye animation no longer blocks certain click events, this was blocking hovering over the deck count for the tooltip and the back button on the music options at high corruption

Corruption icon that slides across the bar had a similar problem

Flickering in the ground after playing the tutorial has been fixed

Several small fixes to the tutorial, liquidation should always reactivate after the fight despite triggering the tutorial text or not, triggering double tooltips causing it to lock up is no longer possible, and all the tutorial information should clear more cleanly after completing

Music options have been cleaned up, cd art was getting scrambled in some cases


SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
Steel Demon changed to grant all Gorps 60 power and 30 armor, instead of just one

High Visibility nerfed, reduces corporate card cost by 400, down from 500

Luxury Fork now pulls a rare from both sets of cards instead of only set 1

Salesman Ale fixed to always create a demon if there is room in hand

Inflated Ego now correctly only targets Agents

Memory Wipe now correctly only targets Agents

Keen Awareness hitbox fixed to only target a single Cat

Bio Accelerant hitbox fixed to only target a single Alien

Virtual Blindfold hitbox fixed to only target a single Character

Crawl for Favor hitbox fixed to only target a single Agent

notes.title: Small Update From Corporate
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
Many enemies have been rigged and now have first draft basic animations in place

Some enemy models have been replaced with entirely new ones

Environment assets updated, there are a few battlefield variations now

New music has been added to the battle music playlist

BUG FIXES
[hr][/hr]
Michael Fritz now reduces salary on attack in all situations

Various other card-specific bugs fixed

Modifier enemy names should read correctly now in all cases

Battle music option panel should always automatically close after a fight now

notes.title: Small Hotfix: Difficulty Modifier
notes.notes:
Couple quick changes to the new damage difficulty scaling
[hr][/hr]
An enemy damage modifier value has been added in the custom game settings, defaulting at 5, you can turn it off entirely by setting it to 0  

Bug fix, the tooltip display value was showing double the actual damage increase value, should always display correctly now

notes.title: Large Update from Corporate 8/24/2025
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
Peter Lurtex, the third boss fight, is now accessible at level 8

Loop Machine added as a new mob that heals when you play corporate cards

Loss condition change, the run only ends if all field slots have been destroyed

All enemy power ranges including bosses now scale up with corruption, increasing the difficulty of the game

Enemies that have 0 power do not get scaled up at all by corruption and still deal 0 damage regardless of corruption level

Drawing from an empty deck now destroys a random field slot. Empty field slots are not given priority over occupied field slots like with most enemy attacks

Deck count UI has been slightly separated visually from your salary/budget

Starting pack tickets reduced to 20, down from 30, other means of acquiring cards are in the works for future updates



SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
Chaos Demon now creates a Gorp in your hand instead of a meteor

Snowball changed to create a meteor in hand if there is room on death instead of returning to hand

Protection Angel now reads "The enemy cannot do anything until after your next turn"

Protection Angel is now connected to the enemy when played, if that enemy dies the next one will not be prevented from action even if it is still the same turn you played the Angel



BUGS
[hr][/hr]
Pack tickets should no longer reset to 30 on save and reload

Damon's triple attack should no longer be able to trigger on death effects more than once

Fixed a bug where the rotation of the main map would sometimes `initialize regardless of mouse click

Protection Angel no longer grants double salary gains after playing

Pollinator should always generate the Angel Egg now

Pollinator is now recognized as being of the ALIEN tribe/character type and should trigger other cards accordingly

notes.title: Update From Corporate 8/17/2025
notes.notes:
GENERAL CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
All enemies now grow stronger as you progress through the game, including bosses. This is a direct difficulty increase to the entire game

There is a new modifier for tickets you start a run with

New runs now start with a default of 30 tickets up from 10

Small transition cutscenes between phase 1 and 2 of boss fights replaced for now



CARD SPECIFIC CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
Instructor Garth: On play damage has been increased from 70 to 120

Alice Gray: On play damage for each Agent in play increased from 20 to 40

Factory Drone: Cost reduced from 1000 to 500 power reduced from 50 to 20

Hitman:

Power and HP  both reduced from 50 to 30

Cost increased to 1400 up from 1250

Salary gain reduced from +150 to +100



BUG FIXES
[hr][/hr]
The liquidate button should no longer be visible until it's usable in the tutorial

Effects that create a card in your hand if there is room, should no longer be able to increase your hand size above the cap of 5

The card Upgrade should no longer grant double the power bonus

SFX fixed on custom game options and start menu

XP bar tooltip glitch fixed

The cheat that deals damage to your own characters should no longer be able to deal multiple instances of damage at a time, resulting in less bugs

Office Grunt has been removed from the modifier list so that there is always at least one viable mob

Ticket display in the collection/deckbuilding screen should now always accurately show how many tickets you have collected

Bug that sometimes set shop tickets to 80 in certain cases should be fixed

notes.title: Small Changes from Corporate 8/9/2025
notes.notes:
Some card design adjustments and bug fixes, nothing too special here!


[hr][/hr]
GENERAL CHANGES

New tooltips when hovering character cards in hand, showing their tribe type and damage type

Flavor text added to a bunch of enemies

Save system should now be protected from corrupting when migrating to new build. This one is a work in progress. If variables start tweaking out you should always be able to reset all save data in the settings menu to fix/zero out to default.

Tutorial should be less buggy

Enemies should no longer be able to spawn on top of each other

New mob Office Grunt, grants the player 300 budget when killed

Second boss enrage wasn't triggering, now it will attack up to 6 times below half hp

Death condition where your field hand and deck were empty should no longer bug out audio

Liquidation should always work now except for the first few turns of the tutorial


[hr][/hr]
SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES

Ken Fieri changed to doomed grunt, spawns an intern on death

Consume changed to broad horizon, fill all open field slots with small aliens

Manipulator armor reduced from 15 to 12, Power reduced from 70 to 60

Twisted Husk changed to gain 20 power each time you play another alien

Factory Drone effect changed to shuffle an upgrade into your deck each time you play another robot, power reduced from 70 to 50

Cordell Keebler salary reduction changed from -200 to -100

Dave Divorcee cost reduced from 400 to 300

Consumer should no longer overheal

Dorry, Muscle Man damage on play increased from 30 to 60

Needletown Militia change to Hitman, On play: deal 100 stealth damage, and gain +150 salary. Cost changed from 800 to 1250

Franz, Artist has been changed to fill all open field slots with small cats on play

Deep Freeze damage increased from 30 to 60 ice damage for each character on the field

Upgrade changed to grant 20 power instead of 30

Void Grip cost reduced from 750 to 500 and now deals 100 Void damage to all available targets

notes.title: Central Chain City Banking Update - 8/7/2025
notes.notes:
SAVINGS MECHANIC
[hr][/hr]
Savings is a new currency that allows progression to persists between runs

Collected cards, xp gained, and budget spent are converted into savings, granted at the end of your run during the new post-loss performance review

At the end of every run you will have a chance to spend savings to permanently collect a copy of any cards that were in your deck when the run ended



OTHER
[hr][/hr]
The main combat camera for the players turn is now fixed with the ability to rotate the field and zoom with the mouse/mouse wheel

Handful of new enemies introduced to random encounter fights after the first boss

Playtesting cheats have been updated - codes in the discord

The new game button in settings has been split into clear all progress and end run

The collection system has been reworked a bit for better performance, duplicates will now stack

The amount of fights remaining is now displayed in the top-right of the combat UI

Various small visual/audio changes



SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES
[hr][/hr]
Benson Grey has been changed to create a field slot on death

Consumer's healing has been reduced from a full heal to restoring 20 HP on attack

Gene Separation has been changed to cost 100, sacrifice any character to create a random alien in your hand

Meteor Queen has been buffed to now deal 30 damage to all of your characters instead of 50

Electricity Modifier buffed to deal 250 lightning damage for a cost of 200

Ambush changed to deal 130 stealth damage in total if used when the enemy is at full health

Execution Trap changed to draw a card, and then deal 120 damage if there are 5 or less cards in your deck

notes.title: Large Update from Corporate - 8/3/2025
notes.notes:
Fairly large update here~

CORE GAMEPLAY:
[hr][/hr]
Random encounters have been added

10 new enemies have been added-

(many are placeholder models without animations but the gameplay is there)

New enemy mechanics introduced like card destruction, corruption increase, etc.

Hovering over enemies now shows their name, power, and effects

Boss nodes appear on the map at levels 3 and 6

Leveling is simplified a bit, 1500 xp granted from random encounters and 3000 from bosses

The Corruption mechanic has been redesigned

In addition to bleeding resources at 100 corruption you now get one card from the top of your deck destroyed when you pass the turn with full corruption

Corruption rises by 10 every time you pass the turn (more than before)

Liquidation has been changed to REDUCE corruption by 5, in addition to the 100 budget gain



CARD ACQUISITION:
[hr][/hr]
Random encounter nodes grant +7 pack tickets

Boss encounters grant +15 pack tickets

Selling cards now grants one pack ticket



OTHER:
[hr][/hr]
Tons of individual card bug fixes - I'm sure some still exist

Parallax added to the cards for some better handling feel

UI has been updated heavily, lots of new tooltips

The tutorial has been reworked quite a bit, it's still not perfect but it should at least get new players started quickly without too much info-dumping

notes.title: Update from Corporate - 07/20/2025
notes.notes:
Corporate has heard your complaints...

[hr][/hr]

UPDATE LOG:

New quick-start tutorial button has been added as an option

Character cards have new models with animations

Profit now increases over time, this is the experience/leveling system of the game.

On level up you gain +10 shop tickets

Some card illustrations have been changed

Text on all cards has been made larger and clearer

You can now hover over the bosses resistance icons to display damage type names

Damage numbers have been redesigned with a background for clarity

New arrow visuals to indicate viable card targets when a card is selected

A small line is now drawn from selected cards to the mouse

BUG LOG:

Passwords had a case sensitivity bug that has been fixed

Boss attack hitboxes have been adjusted to not sometimes cleave unintentionally

Cards that target specific types are now unable to be played unless the target type is present

Volume sliders no longer disconnect on "new game" reload

Various minor UI changes, settings menu rearrangement, etc.

Created cards should now always remain the correct size

CARD-SPECIFIC FIXES:

Constable effect is now working

Shore goliath collider has been fixed

Factory drone collider has been fixed

Torch and other cards with type targeting have been fixed

Ken Fieri now correctly creates Big Jim if there is room in hand

Tom, Chainsmoker properly shuffles smokes into your deck now
